# Atelier Predict

> Motor de pronóstico de demanda con IA agéntica para el retail colombiano.
> Pronóstico estadístico (Holt-Winters con estacionalidad semanal) sobre datos de
> consumo reales, más un agente en Amazon Bedrock que convierte el pronóstico en
> acciones concretas. Construido para el hackathon AWS Zero to Shipped 2026.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a plain-text map of the site intended
for language models and autonomous agents. It is not a substitute for the HTML.

## What this site is

- A demand forecasting dashboard for retail, in Spanish and English.
- The forecast is computed by a statistical model and scored against a baseline
  on a held-out window, so the accuracy figure on the page is auditable.
- A conversational agent explains the forecast and can propose campaign and
  inventory actions. It receives the statistical output as ground truth and
  cannot invent demand numbers.

## Routes

- `/` — landing, Spanish. Identical content to `/es`.
- `/es` — landing, Spanish.
- `/en` — landing, English.
- `/es/privacidad` — privacy policy (Spanish). `/en/privacy` — English.
- `/es/terminos` — terms and conditions. `/en/terms` — English.
- `/es/cookies` — cookie policy. `/en/cookies` — English.
- `/es/reembolsos` — refund policy. `/en/refunds` — English.

The landing page is a client-rendered single page app. Sections are anchored as
`#kpis`, `#pronostico`, `#agente` and `#contacto`.

## Key technical facts

- Forecast model: additive Holt-Winters triple exponential smoothing, weekly
  seasonal period (m=7), with a 14-day holdout backtest against a seasonal-naive
  baseline.
- Reported accuracy on the holdout: WAPE 7.77% for the model versus 10.17% for
  the baseline; mean absolute error 13.97 versus 18.29 units per day.
- Savings figures are derived from that backtest, not invented: 4.32 fewer
  wrong units per day priced at a COP 18,500 unit contribution margin.
- Agent: Claude Sonnet 4.5 through Amazon Bedrock (cross-region inference
  profile), using the Converse API with tool use.
- Infrastructure: AWS Lambda behind API Gateway HTTP API, provisioned with
  CloudFormation. Static frontend on AWS Amplify Hosting.

## Important caveats

- This is a hackathon MVP. The demo dataset is synthetic.
- The legal pages are reference drafts and require legal review before being
  published as binding policy.
- The agent's actions are proposed, not executed against a live ad or messaging
  platform.
